note: R101 P0 (PULPIT_R101_2026-10-28 §7, §8, §10, §12): the desktop layer under the windows - always mounted, drawn where no window covers it. Everything here is a preset (CLAUDE.md: lists are examples): the sections and their order (setting desktop_sections overrides), the texts, the last_window_close values the page knows (setting last_window_close, an open value) and the emergency path (setting desktop_emergency_path). An unknown section id is skipped with the advisory desktop_section_unknown, never an error. P0 was the mechanism; D2 adds the section `icons` (the pins of the desktop, PULPIT_R101 §4) and the faint graph under them, both from the view declaration chosen by the setting desktop_declaration (`declarations`, preset pulpit_graf). Sections listed in sections_more are drawn behind the button "Więcej" (and a long press on the empty desktop), so nothing P0 offered disappears.

icons.note: R101 D2: the icons of the desktop - nodes pinned to it (perspective pinned_on read from the kernel), laid out by the coordinates of the declaration (icon_grid); a tap opens the target (open_targets)

sentence.note: a sentence goes to the chat composer of a chat window (restored or opened), the same route as typing it there

restore.note: minimized windows of the layout, a tap restores one

open.note: every kind of window_kinds.json; a planned kind or a kind the page cannot open by itself yet is shown greyed with its reason, never hidden

layouts.note: the shipped layouts and the person's saved ones (W5)

sentence.note: true: the sentence is sent from the composer at once; false: it waits in the composer

emergency.note: the one path kept when the sections leave none (B3); setting desktop_emergency_path=false switches it off, the desktop then says what is missing (advisory desktop_no_path)

last_window_close.note: open value: desktop | close_app | reopen:<kind> | layout:<id> [examples]; an unknown value is read as desktop with the advisory last_window_close_unknown

hint.pl: Tu zawsze możesz otworzyć nowe okno.
hint.en: From here you can always open a new window.

sentence_label.en: Write what you want to do

unavailable_cannot_open.pl: Ten rodzaj okna otwiera się dziś tylko z innego okna; strona nie umie go jeszcze otworzyć sama.
unavailable_cannot_open.en: This kind of window opens today only from another window; the page cannot open it by itself yet.

show_receipt.pl: Widać pulpit; okna są zwinięte, „cofnij układ” je przywróci.
show_receipt.en: The desktop is shown; the windows are minimized, “undo layout” brings them back.

show_receipt_noop.pl: Pulpit już jest widoczny; nic nie zwinięto.
show_receipt_noop.en: The desktop is already shown; nothing was minimized.

background_kind.pl: To jest ten pulpit: jest zawsze pod oknami, jeden na układ; pokazuje go „pokaż pulpit” (Ctrl+Shift+D).
background_kind.en: This is the desktop itself: always under the windows, one per layout; “show the desktop” (Ctrl+Shift+D) shows it.

no_path.pl: Na pulpicie nie ma teraz żadnej drogi do otwarcia okna, bo wyłączono sekcje i drogę awaryjną. Czy to celowe?
no_path.en: The desktop has no way to open a window now: the sections and the emergency path are switched off. Is that intended?

last_close_unknown.pl: Nieznana wartość „po zamknięciu ostatniego okna”: {value}; zostaje pulpit.
last_close_unknown.en: Unknown value of “after the last window closes”: {value}; the desktop stays.

ended_text.pl: Zamknięto ostatnie okno, a ustawienie mówi: zamknij program. Przeglądarka może odmówić zamknięcia karty, której nie otworzył skrypt - wtedy zamknij ją sam.
ended_text.en: The last window was closed and the setting says: close the program. The browser may refuse to close a tab no script opened - then close it yourself.

icons_error.pl: Nie udało się wczytać ikon pulpitu: {error}
icons_error.en: Could not load the desktop icons: {error}

desktop_empty.pl: Na pulpicie nie ma ikon. Przypnij coś zdaniem, np. „przypnij rozmowy do pulpitu”.
desktop_empty.en: The desktop has no icons. Pin something with a sentence, e.g. “pin conversations on the desktop”.

declaration_unknown.en: Unknown desktop declaration “{id}”; the default ({preset}) is used.

element_unsupported.pl: Element deklaracji pulpitu, którego ta strona nie rysuje, pominięty: {id} ({kind}).
element_unsupported.en: A desktop declaration element this page does not draw, skipped: {id} ({kind}).

graph_label.pl: Twój graf w tle: węzłów {n}, krawędzi {e}

nothing_visible.pl: Graf w tle jest niewidoczny (krycie 0). Czy to celowe?
nothing_visible.en: The graph behind is invisible (opacity 0). Is that intended?

pulpit_graf.note: PULPIT_R101 §3.2 [preset, the default chosen by the owner 2026-10-28]: the pinned nodes as icons, the rest of the person's graph faint, only that it exists. Every number is a preset.

elements.seed_note: the first pins, written once as ordinary pinned_on links (window.pin) when the desktop node does not exist yet; the person may unpin any of them - examples, not a rule (owner's list + his associations, PULPIT §4.3)

pulpit_ikony.note: PULPIT_R101 §3.1 [preset]: only the pins, no graph behind them (pulpit_graf with the rest at opacity 0). The other concepts are D3.

open_targets.note: address of an icon -> the window it opens (longest prefix wins; $address = the whole address, $rest = what follows the prefix). The kind goes through window_kinds.json: a planned kind is shown greyed with its reason, a kind the page cannot open yet too. An address no prefix knows opens fallback. Examples, an open list.

address_labels.note: the label of an icon when the pin carries no label_override (a representative node is labelled with its address): longest prefix wins, else the node's own label. Examples.

glyphs.note: the sign of an icon by the longest address prefix (element icon, glyph: address) - plain text symbols, a preset; a node's own metadata.glyph or the pin's glyph wins.
